column1: # Menu box geometry — Shiren GB
# Box width is byte 3 of a descriptor in the table bank 31 indexes at $45D5, and x/y are
# bytes 0 and 1, so making a menu box wider is a data edit. See extract.box_descriptors.
# The drawer (31:$40D8) writes a left border tile, `width` CELLS, then a right border
# tile, so a box occupies columns x .. x+width+1 and rows y .. y+rows+1. Screen is 20x18.
# A row shorter than `width` is blank-padded by the drawer, so widening a box never
# requires re-padding its text.
# The first cell is the CURSOR SLOT on any selectable list -- those rows start with a
# space in the original and the inserter re-adds it, so a 7-wide box holds 6 letters.
# build.py checks that every row fits `width` and that the box fits the screen. It CANNOT
# check that the box looks right, or that it does not cover something another routine drew.
# SCREENSHOT EVERY BOX LISTED HERE.
# A fifth field `nocursor` marks a box with no selection cursor (a header or a message).
# Without it, moving a box makes build.py move the cursor entry too -- and refuse if the
# box shares its cursor home with another, since the entries are keyed on position.
# box
# V4C restores the Japanese x=13,w=5 geometry. The first cell remains the cursor and Dot
# VWF paints every complete staged verb into the remaining 32px; `Remove` is the exact
# 40px edge case including that cursor cell. The cursor table at 4:$4E6E moves back with
# both boxes (box 6 has three entries, one per category verb set).
# `Floor` lets shared box 0 return to the Japanese width 5. Box 1 therefore returns to
# x=7,w=11 and both boxes are packed exactly as in the original. Its live values remain
# at their original absolute column 18 positions.
# Boxes 20/21 stay one cell wider than Japanese. Static analysis proves their descriptors
# currently have no draw call, so there is no live route on which to validate a narrow
# proportional scanner; keeping width 6 also preserves every English row if one is found.
# The category pages return to the Japanese width 5 where possible. Box 33 fits exactly;
# box 34 needs one extra cell because `Weapon` paints 43px including the cursor.
# Dot VWF lets `Normal` fit the Japanese x=12,w=6 geometry. Its cursor table entry moves
# back with the box.
